storyCards.headline: Just Can't Get Enough: A Cultural Moment Captured on Record
storyCards.fact:
Depeche Mode's "Just Can't Get Enough" — original release 1981. "Just Can't Get Enough" is a song by the English electronic band Depeche Mode.

It was their third single, released on 7 September 1981, a month before the release of their debut studio album, Speak & Spell.

It was recorded during the summer of that year at Blackwing Studios, and was the band's first single to be released in the United States, on 18 February 1982.

The discography of English electronic music band Depeche Mode consists of 15 studio albums, six live albums, nine compilation albums, 24 box sets and 61 singles.
